backlog.purpose: Rank all candidate writings by evidence strength, surprise, audience fit and zero-cost finishability.
backlog.success: At least one eligible non-published item has zero_cost_path=true.

pick.success: Article selected and branch slug defined.

harvest.purpose: Collect primary source code, result artifacts, CI logs, upstream PRs, papers/specs and contradictory evidence.
harvest.success: Consequential claims can be mapped to inspectable artifacts.

recover.purpose: Recover from insufficient or inaccessible evidence without spending money.

park.purpose: Record the exact unblock condition and immediately return to the queue.
park.success: backlog item has explicit blocker and unblock_condition.

claim_lock.purpose: Lock decision question, one-sentence falsifiable claim, and evidence boundary.
claim_lock.success: Claim can be disproved and does not outrun evidence.

evidence_ledger.purpose: Classify each hard claim as observed, derived, estimated or target and attach exact provenance.
evidence_ledger.success: All consequential claims have class, source, denominator/units if applicable, and reproduction status.

quant_gate.purpose: Attack denominators, samples, seeds, uncertainty, baselines, subset definitions, stale assumptions and parameter sensitivity.

draft.purpose: Write result-first draft using the research template.
draft.success: Draft contains result, method, evidence, interpretation, rival, limitations, update condition and reproducibility.

red_team.purpose: Construct and test the strongest rival explanation.

robustness.purpose: Run zero-cost sensitivity checks and expose unresolved sensitivity when reruns are unavailable.
robustness.success: Conclusion is stable enough under plausible alternatives or explicitly narrowed.

visuals.purpose: Create only figures/tables that carry evidence with units, denominator, provenance and uncertainty.
visuals.success: Every visual has a textual takeaway and provenance.

repro.purpose: Expose exact command/code/data/config/log needed to inspect or recreate results.
repro.success: Reproduction artifact is linked or impossibility is explicit.

citation_gate.purpose: Verify every source supports the exact adjacent claim and evidence classes are not blurred.

editorial.purpose: Compress prose and verify headline/dek/conclusion are no stronger than evidence.
editorial.success: Article reads quickly without hiding uncertainty or boundaries.

final_gate.purpose: Require Provenance, Quantitative Validity, Adversarial Thesis, Citation Integrity, Reproducibility and Editorial gates.

route_failure.purpose: Route failure to the earliest responsible node instead of patching prose locally.

publish.purpose: Merge article, update writing index, source links, version/revision log, and backlog status.
publish.success: Published article is discoverable from writing index and traceable to source artifacts.

propagate.purpose: Update work/profile cross-links only when the article materially improves the public evidence story.

retrospective.purpose: Record what the loop caught and strengthen the process if a failure pattern repeats.
retrospective.success: At least one lesson or explicit 'no new process lesson' is recorded.

revision_on_new_evidence.purpose: Reopen a published article when new evidence changes a claim, number or limitation.

gates.A_provenance: Every consequential factual claim traces to primary evidence.
gates.B_quantitative_validity: Numbers expose denominator, units, assumptions and uncertainty/sensitivity where material.
gates.C_adversarial_thesis: Strongest rival explanation is tested or explicitly unresolved.
gates.D_citation_integrity: Sources support exact adjacent claims; observed/derived/estimated/target are distinguished.
gates.E_reproducibility: Artifacts are linked or reproduction impossibility is explicit.
gates.editorial: Headline, dek and conclusion do not exceed the body.
